text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! Congratulations on your new ZZ plant! 🌿

You're in good time. Orders can be changed free of charge within **2 hours** of ordering, and at 20 minutes in you have roughly 1 hour 40 minutes left. To make a change:

- Go to **"My Orders"** on the website or app.
- Select your ZZ plant order and look for the change options.

I can't confirm from my information whether adding a new item to an existing order is one of the changes "My Orders" allows. If you don't see an option to add a pot, let me know and I can pass it to our support team.

If the 2 hours pass, the order moves into the packing queue and can't be changed online. Support can try to catch it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed.

Your plant will arrive in a plastic nursery pot with drainage holes, so it's ready to go either way. Decorative pots are sold separately unless a listing says "potted".

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy planting! 🪴
